head: 360ad89cabf649b399370e11554e600f5be5ae99
notes: Prior low (retired objects only freed by BeginFrame) is FIXED by CanFreeRetiredNow + Dispose in UpdateMesh/DestroyMesh/DestroyTexture. Safety argument: frame fences are created SIGNALED and are reset only in EndFrame, under _mutex, immediately before the vkQueueSubmit that signals them; a reset followed by a failed submit leaves the fence unsignalled (CanFreeRetiredNow then returns false, conservative) and sets _deviceLost. The only other submissions are SubmitOneTime (fence-less, followed by vkQueueWaitIdle before returning, all under the same lock), so every submitted command buffer that may reference a mesh/texture is either complete or guarded by a frame fence; all fences signalled => every frame submission (and, single in-order queue, everything before it) is done. The only state where a command buffer is recorded but not submitted is _frameOpen (rejected); EndFrame clears _frameOpen and submits inside one lock hold, its vkEndCommandBuffer-failure early-out never submits that buffer (and BeginFrame is then blocked by _deviceLost), AbandonOpenFrame resets the buffer without submitting. CanFreeRetiredNow and the free run in the same _mutex critical section as the public method. vkGetFenceStatus errors (device lost) or a null fence keep the deferred path; Shutdown still frees after vkDeviceWaitIdle. Tests: deferral assertions are all made with a frame open (deterministic); the immediate-free assertions follow a synchronous upload or no frame at all (fences signalled deterministically); 10000 UpdateMesh before any frame asserts 0 pending and 2 live allocations every 1000 iterations, plus 200 create/destroy cycles. Docs: the single 'newest that can' sentence was extended correctly; no other statement in application.html is now false. Optional nit (not a finding): the testing.html row for VulkanResourceTests.cpp does not mention the new immediate-free/no-frame tests. Delta since d2a47bd touches only VulkanResources.cpp, VulkanRenderer.hpp, VulkanResourceTests.cpp, application.html plus a clean master merge; VMA/LICENSE/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/CMake unchanged; PR file list unchanged and within allowed paths; no attribution text.
